author: StewieFG
body:
First of all, I'm not suggesting that because I'm banned, it's because iv'e seen it in alot of servers, just want to hear your opinions.

So yeah, many servers have unban in their server store,
Ex: First unban: $10
       Second unban: $20
       Third unban: $35
Just an example.

Well, I know every user that has money will buy the unbans, but sometimes you have the give the players second chance. And I think it should be limited that they can't but the second and third unban if they have more than 2 pages of infractions.

Also, I don't think players that have been banned for: DDoS, Crashing Avicus Services, Ban evading etc, shouldn't have the ability to buy unbans.

Just a suggestion, opinions below :)

title: [SUGGESTION] Unban

replies.author: PictureFrames
replies.body:
I don't think this will be added.

First of all, if a player gets banned they have a chance to appeal, by emailing support@avicus.net. If their appeal passes through and is up to scratch, they will be unbanned. However if they are to get banned a second time... I don't think they deserve to appeal again. Whether that be by paying for it, or by apologizing in an email.

replies.author: Tarheelkiwi
replies.body:
I see how this could be helpful (Avicus gets money), but think about all the bad players we want out of Avicus for good.  They would just keep paying to get unbanned.  I like this idea though, but this is how it should work:

A Must appeal using email first.  If he/she was accepted, he/she doesn't have to pay.  But, if he/she was denied, he/she can pay.  However, they only get 3 unbans to pay.  After that, they must appeal. 

It is going to be tough to get this approved, so I feel like we should have a "Ban Appeal" tab on the forums.  Since not everybody has access to email.

If players could buy unbans, then we would see a lot  A LOT more hackers and rule breakers on our servers.

Also, bans would become obsolete if all you had to do was pay $10 to come back.

As stated before, it would do more harm than good and probably wont be added in the near future.

If players want a second chance, they can appeal by emailing support at:
support@avicus.net

The fact that you can appeal IS your second chance.
